subject: general
question: The base of the right-angled triangle is 3 m greater than its height. If its hypotenuse is 15 m, then find its area.
solution:
Given:

Hypotenuse = 15 m

Base of the right-angled triangle is 3 m greater than its height. 

Concept Used:

Pythagoras Theorem

H2 = P2 + B2

Area of right-angled triangle = 1/2 × base × height
